type.description: mcq: single correct option. select_all: one or more correct options. fill_blank: single typed answer, exact match after trim. write_code: learner submits code, graded by executing it against test_cases.

options.description: Required for mcq and select_all. The list of choices shown to the learner.

answer.description: Required for mcq and fill_blank. The single correct answer.

answers.description: Required for select_all. All options that must be selected (and no others) to be marked correct.

test_cases.description: Required for write_code. Learner's code is run once per test case.

input.description: Text piped to stdin, for programs that call input(). Omit if the program takes no input.

expected_output.description: Expected stdout, compared after trimming trailing whitespace.

xp.description: XP awarded on a correct submission. Defaults to 10 if omitted.

misconception_map.description: Maps a wrong answer (mcq/fill_blank) or a wrong-but-common option (select_all) to a misconception_id. Not used for write_code, which reports failed test cases instead.
